content: slowapi: create Limiter(key_func=get_remote_address), set app.state.limiter, register RateLimitExceeded exception handler BEFORE app.add_middleware(SlowAPIMiddleware) (handler registration must precede middleware add), then decorate specific endpoints with @limiter.limit(...) or set default_limits on the Limiter for a global default. Endpoint functions must accept a Request parameter or slowapi cannot key on it. No official guidance on ordering vs CORSMiddleware; convention is CORS should still wrap 429 responses with proper headers, which argues for adding CORSMiddleware after (outside) SlowAPIMiddleware.
